acceptance_criteria.description: The managed stdio probe launches the clean real Tinto copy through tauri_launch and reaches state READY before bounded surface discovery and close.
When managed launch fails and cleanup also cannot complete, status and diagnostics preserve the original launch code and phase instead of masking it with CLOSE_FAILED.

Normal close and retry cleanup are idempotent, report truthful pending labels, and leave no Pumarejo-owned process, provider port, empty session directory, manifest, or quarantine residue for the proving run.
Focused runtime, session, Windows process, tracked-process, and artifact-store regression tests pass without weakening existing ownership or destructive-filesystem protections.

closed_decisions: Use the existing clean disposable Tinto proving copy and its MSVC Rust toolchain configuration; do not retry the known-broken GNU toolchain.
Preserve the public MCP contract and leave DEC-2026-08-25-008 unresolved; this unit must not expose or rename a dialog operation.
Preserve ownership-safe process custody, link/race defenses, explicit artifact-retention policy, and the real broker-capable provider.
Cleanup failure must never replace the original managed launch failure as the observable lastFailure.
No absolute machine path may be introduced into product, package, generated, or configuration sources.

focused: pnpm vitest run tests/unit/mcp-runtime.test.ts tests/unit/session-manager.test.ts tests/unit/tracked-process.test.ts tests/unit/windows-process.test.ts tests/integration/artifact-store.test.ts

forbidden_changes: Do not add, remove, or rename public MCP tools or schemas.
Do not change Tinto companion sources or vendor provider behavior.
Do not weaken ownership, custody, nonce, process identity, artifact identity, symlink, reparse-point, quarantine, or retention safeguards.
Do not add dependencies or edit package manifests, lockfiles, release configuration, Jira state, commits, branches, or pull requests.
Do not edit queue, blocker, initiative, roadmap, Compound state, or release evidence artifacts.
objective: Diagnose and fix managed stdio launch of the clean real Tinto proving copy so tauri_launch reaches READY, the original launch failure remains observable when cleanup also has trouble, and artifact/process cleanup converges idempotently without owned residue.
